# Episode e01 recovery inputs

Six original Z-Image-Turbo paintings from run 40113702992 retain their exact painter prompts. Beat 4 uses the
accepted first alternate. The metadata records the source artifact, seed and SHA-256 of each PNG. These are
generated fiction images; the pipeline uses the existing Apache-2.0 model stack.

The planner copies an input only while its story, prompt and image hash match. It repaints beat 5's corrected
radio reveal. Every image is screened again by the current picture editor; none carries a publishing exemption.
The compositor, voice checks, upload identity and readback requirements all remain in force.
